verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of data-retention policies, deletion controls, GDPR/CCPA compliance, or privacy settings for Terraform or HCP Terraform's stored state/logs. State-management docs (terraform state rm, import) address infrastructure resource tracking, not user data privacy controls, so they cannot substitute. missing for 10: any documentation of retention windows, deletion APIs/commands for user or telemetry data, or privacy/compliance policy pages.
